# External validation tables (generated by scripts/build_external_and_draft.py)

Independent cohort: Gornale & Patravali, Digital Knee X-ray Images (Mendeley Data, CC BY 4.0), Expert-I labels, 1,650 images. Fixed split: 30% development (n=495, used for any adaptation) / 70% held-out test (n=1,155, all values below). Mean ± sample SD over seeds (n shown). Only the Zero-shot row is clean generalization; the other rows adapt to the target site. Short-schedule rows use a 40-epoch schedule and must only be compared with each other. No patient IDs exist in this cohort, so images of one patient may fall on both sides of the split.
